# arin_irr_linked_route (Resource)

Own an existing ROA-linked IRR route, including its independent deletion. Import by CIDR,AS<number> before applying. ARIN creates links through RPKI, so this resource cannot create or recreate a linked route. Updates manage description, user remarks and membership. Destroy deletes only the IRR route and clears its ROA's per-prefix link flag; the ROA authorization remains. Use arin_irr_route_metadata when Terraform also manages the owning ROA or bundle, since its auto_link setting can otherwise recreate a deleted route. Do not overlap route ownership with other resources. A changed or removed ROA link blocks writes until ownership is reconciled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Import this existing linked route before applying.
# The owning ROA is managed outside this Terraform resource.
resource "arin_irr_linked_route" "example" {
  prefix              = "192.0.2.0/24"
  origin_as           = "AS19814"
  org_handle          = "EXAMPLE-1"
  expected_roa_handle = "ROA-HANDLE"
  description         = ["Independently managed customer route"]
  remarks             = ["Routing contact: noc@example.net"]
}

# Destroy deletes the IRR route but leaves its ROA authorization intact.
# Use arin_irr_route_metadata when Terraform also manages the owning ROA/bundle.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (List of String) Ordered description lines, at least one. Each entry is one nonempty line without surrounding whitespace.
- `expected_roa_handle` (String) Exact nonempty ROA handle required for updates and deletion. Import initializes this to the observed link. Changing this field does not create or change an ARIN link.
- `org_handle` (String) Immutable imported route identity. Keep this value known and unchanged; import a different target into a separate resource.
- `origin_as` (String) Immutable imported route identity. Keep this value known and unchanged; import a different target into a separate resource.
- `prefix` (String) Immutable imported route identity. Keep this value known and unchanged; import a different target into a separate resource.

### Optional

- `member_of` (Set of String) Route sets containing this route. Defaults to empty; omission clears membership. For membership by reference, the route set must authorize this route's maintainer in members_by_ref.
- `remarks` (List of String) Ordered remarks lines. Defaults to empty; omission clears existing remarks on apply.

### Read-Only

- `auto_linked_roa_handle` (String) Currently observed ROA link, or empty for an unlinked route.
- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `id` (String) Canonical prefix and origin ASN separated by a comma, for example 192.0.2.0/24,AS64496. Also used as the import ID.
- `last_modified_date` (String) Last modification timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `net_handle` (String) Network registration handle assigned by ARIN.
- `poc_links` (Attributes Set) POC links generated by ARIN from the maintaining organization. These cannot be configured or changed on the IRR route. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))
- `server_remarks` (List of String) ARIN-generated link annotation, excluded from writable remarks.
- `source` (String) IRR source returned by ARIN.

<a id="nestedatt--poc_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poc_links`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) POC role description returned by ARIN.
- `function` (String) POC role returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) POC handle returned by ARIN.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arin_irr_linked_route.example 192.0.2.0/24,AS19814
```
